title: Security Radar site-data (published to S3, read by the UI)
description: Root documents. events.json = {kind:'events'}, events/<id>.json = {kind:'event'}, sources.json = {kind:'sources'}, mitigate.json = {kind:'mitigate'}. feeds/index.json = {kind:'feeds'} (feeds/<name>.json are JSON Feed 1.1, feeds/<name>.atom Atom 1.0). Every root document carries schema_version.

Level.description: Verification level computed by code. V0 rumor, V1 reported, V2 corroborated, V3 confirmed, V4 finalized, X disputed/retracted/rolled_back.

Exploitation.description: Exploitation status (sighting axis, independent of verification level).

level_reason.description: Machine-generated explanation of why this level (which evidence satisfied which rule).

summary.description: LLM summary (M2). null when not generated or unavailable.

velocity_6h.description: Independent source groups whose first report is within the last 6h.

analysis_status.description: ok=all sentences grounded; partial=some sentences failed checks (shown greyed); pending=not generated yet; failed=LLM error (reason in analysis); not_applicable=below P1.

amount_frozen_latest.description: Largest freeze reported for the event (USD), null when none.

confidence.description: stated = a T1/T2 report names the actor; suspected = only community / flash news

triage.description: Operator disposition (radar.triage, set by scripts/triage.py with IAM credentials); null = not dispositioned

tx_confirmed.description: Attack transactions whose receipt was read on chain as successful (radar.chain); a rise updates P0 push threads.

summary_source.description: brief = the first grounded BLUF sentence that does not contradict the code's fields; code = the code's own summary.

summary_rejected.description: Why grounded BLUF sentences were passed over (analyst.contradiction).

ghsas.description: GitHub Security Advisory ids named by the event's reports (the identifier before a CVE is assigned).

evidence_at.description: Timeline position: published_at, but a date-only entry is never earlier than the event's first report (pipeline.evidence_at)

independent_group.description: Items sharing a group number are echoes of the same original source.

phase.description: Attack stage of the report, from its title (radar.stages.of_title).

published_is_collected.description: source gave no publication time; published_at is the capture time

date_only.description: source gave a date without a time

kind.description: Which measure the amount is (pipeline._amounts): only loss feeds the headline and the dispute flag; frozen feeds amount_frozen_latest.

verified.description: C6 on-chain verdict (radar.chain): receipt status 1 = confirmed, 0 = failed (reverted), none = not_found; unsupported = no EVM receipt endpoint for this chain

degraded.description: Why the source is served by a fallback channel (e.g. X via firecrawl when the X data source is out of quota); null when not degraded.

Lifecycle.description: Code-computed lifecycle word: escalating=new evidence/upgrade in 24h, active=updated in 72h, cooling=3–14d quiet, finalized=V4, dormant=>14d.

grounded.description: true only if every cite exists and every number appears in the cited text

at.description: evidence publication time that made this stage true; null = not reached

status.description: unchecked = no target hit, but at least one relevant target was not actually checked (version not comparable, review blocked or failed) — never rendered as 未命中.

ImpactSummary.description: Compact 'does it hit us' chip for lists and the wall (from AWS Continuum / Security Agent results).

match.description: exact = the line itself is the exposure; heuristic = candidate shape for the AWS agents to confirm.

CodeLocation.description: Deterministic locator hit: an affected version pinned in target code.

requirement_hit.description: Finding was raised against the radar-generated requirement.

evidence_summary.description: Continuum validation source-analysis walk (entry → sink → guards), truncated.

pr_url.description: Pull request opened by AWS Continuum in the GitHub repository (GitHub patch delivery).

path.description: Site-relative path of the captured diff (behind the same auth as the site).

pr_url.description: Pull request opened by AWS Continuum in the GitHub repository (GitHub patch delivery).

ResponseDecision.description: One action's decision for this event, from the radar.decisions table (first failing gate decides). not_evaluated = nobody evaluated it (station off, out of window, per-cycle cap, channel not wired) — never the same as not_fire (evaluated, condition not met / already done).

scope.description: target_id (target actions), channel (s3 / github / gitlab) or null (event).

gate.description: Reason code of the gate that decided; null = fire (every gate passed).

at.description: respond rows: when this outcome + gate first held (kept while unchanged); publish rows: the ledger time it was read from.

limit.description: The limit a limit gate read (actual enforced value).

result.description: fire rows: the issued call's result (respond.apply → decisions.mark_result; publish rows: the ledger's done state). Absent on a fire row = the result was never recorded.

result_at.description: When the result was recorded (a failing retry shows its latest attempt).

reason.description: Code-templated explanation (eligibility, what is running, outcome).

Response.description: 'In your environment': what AWS Continuum + AWS Security Agent did for this event.

channel.description: The ONE Continuum environment that validates this target (src/radar/targets.py CHANNEL); none = Security Agent only

channel_url.description: Where the code lives for that channel (repository URL); null for s3 / none

impact.description: respond.impact() status — the same authority as the event page and the listing chip (ImpactSummary.status). The UI renders this, never a mapping of `status`: done + 0 affected used to read 未命中 for a target nobody checked.

cost.description: Per-day spend of the AWS services the radar drives (Cost Explorer, refreshed every few hours). null until the first read.

error.description: Last read failed (numbers are from fetched_at).

Digest.description: C7 daily digest (radar.digest): header numbers by code, prose by the LLM with per-sentence citations to event ids

PossibleDuplicate.description: C4 cluster_judge: the model judged this published event to be the same incident (advisory; not merged)

AttentionItem.description: D/M3 ops: one thing a human should look at (radar.ops RULES)

RulePack.description: P2 WAF rule pack (radar.rulepack): one customer-owned AWS WAF RuleGroup per event — managed groups, custom rules from verbatim template / evidence features (each gated by the offline matcher), heuristic templates, and every rejected candidate with its reason. Every rule is Count.

no_rule.description: Why nothing can be deployed at the edge for this event (no managed group, no rule from a template or the evidence); null / absent when the pack has something.

href.description: rulepack.quote_href (public doc only): pinned-commit link / http(s) item URL; null = no safe link

span.description: [start, end) of token in rulepack.evidence_text(item) — what --check reads back

href.description: rulepack.quote_href (public doc only): pinned-commit link / http(s) item URL; null = no safe link

Mitigation.description: M3 mitigate station: the fast path next to the patch (never a fix — note says so).

to_exchange.description: Exchange the outflow went into (radar.wallets): a terminal — cash-out or deposit, not followed further

Onchain.description: Minute-level on-chain reconstruction of a P0 web3 incident (radar.onchain). Every row carries its tx; what was not queried is listed.

exchange_inflow_by_exchange.description: USD (stablecoins) that left the attacker's side into each exchange; absent in data published before 2026-11-01

AttackTxs.description: Attack-transaction breakdown (radar.attacktx): ERC-20 transfers of each verified attack tx, per token the largest net gainer / loser.

role.description: 发起地址 (tx sender) / 被调用合约 (tx target) / null

amount.description: token units; null when decimals() is unknown

usd.description: amount × historical USD price at the tx's block time; null when unpriced or low-confidence

role.description: 发起地址 (tx sender) / 被调用合约 (tx target) / null

amount.description: token units; null when decimals() is unknown

usd.description: amount × historical USD price at the tx's block time; null when unpriced or low-confidence
amount × historical USD price at the tx's block time; null when unpriced or low-confidence

native.description: Native coin the transaction itself sends (eth_getTransactionByHash value); null when none or not read yet

price_source.description: How usd values were obtained (DefiLlama historical price at the tx's block time); null when no tx is priced yet.

Followup.description: Incident follow-up so far (radar.insights.followup): on-chain outflows and freezes (radar.onchain), decoded attack txs (radar.attacktx), time of the latest; absent / null when nobody follows it on chain.

TitleOverride.description: An operator's sourced root-cause correction of the title (radar.retitle); the original title is kept.

Disclosure.description: Earliest CVE-record publication among the event's CVEs; lag_hours = radar first_seen − at (≥ 0).

resurfaced.description: lag ≥ Limits.RESURFACED_DAYS: an old CVE back on the radar, not a late detection

Sighting.description: pipeline.sighting: first report published vs radar first capture

Notice.description: One exchange announcement (radar.announcements.board_add); kind decided by code (announcements.kind).

SearchRow.description: One event in the static search index (radar.search.record): id, title, domain, severity, level, first/last date, CVEs, entities, amount; p = the event has a published detail page (absent ⇒ no page, shown without a link).

r.description: R3.5: the source URL of the item that created the event — only on rows without a detail page (no "p"), so a hit without a page still leads somewhere.

AttackStage.description: Attack stage (radar.stages — generated by scripts/gen_stages.py, do not edit). Canonical ids in attack order; drain→asset_transfer, statement→disclosure are legacy M4 values still accepted in documents published before the rename, until 2027-01-15.

ChainStage.description: What the event's on-chain sections confirm for one attack stage (radar.stages.chain_evidence): outflow from a victim → asset_transfer, any other outflow → laundering, issuer freeze → freeze, decoded successful attack tx → asset_transfer, live EIP-7702 delegation → key_access. first_at is the earliest time of the kind's rows on the clock named by `clock`.

clock.description: radar.stages.CLOCK: 'chain' = first_at is the earliest row's block time (when it happened); 'checked' = first_at is when the radar checked (an EIP-7702 delegation read at check time — when it was set is not queried), never an event time

first_tx.description: tx of the earliest row; null for a delegation (eth_getCode has no tx)

SchemaVersion.description: Shape version of a root document (radar.model.SITE_SCHEMA_VERSION). A breaking change bumps it; readers pin the version they were written against.

FeedEntry.description: One pull feed (radar.feeds.FEEDS): JSON Feed 1.1 and Atom 1.0 documents of the newest matching events, behind the site's access control.

AwsFix.description: AWS's own fix status for the event's CVE, from the Amazon Linux Security Center (radar.awsfix). null when the event has no CVE Amazon Linux tracks, or it has not been read yet.

arm64_not_affected.description: the page's description says ARM64 (Graviton) is not affected

AttackPathSentence.description: One grounded sentence of an attack path (radar.attack_path): its cited items and whether code found every number in them.

AttackPath.description: R9.5: how a vulnerability is attacked — entry → condition → trigger → impact, each a list of grounded sentences — and the defences, each placed at the step it stops: block (before the request reaches the code), temporary (a host / configuration change until the fix), fix (the update). Defences with source radar / aws are the radar's own (its WAF rule pack, AWS's fixed builds), placed by code. null when the event is not a P0 / P1 vulnerability or no path was built.

window.description: The publish window before the listing was cut (publish.window_counts): the page says 'listed / total'.

rule_pack.description: P2 WAF rule pack (mitigate station row __rule_pack__#<event_id>); null = no pack for this event

chain_stages.description: On-chain stage evidence (P1b); absent in documents published before 2026-11-11.

decisions.description: 「响应决策」: every action of the radar.decisions table x its decision for this event (radar.decisions.evaluate at publish) — for every event, with or without a response state. Absent on documents published before 2026-11-11.

oneOf.description: mitigate.json — M3 mitigate station: radar-owned web ACLs, per-target Inspector dependency baseline, errors.

detail_cap.description: Limits.PUBLISH_MAX_EVENTS: only this many of the window's events get a detail doc. Absent in indexes written before it existed.

oneOf.description: data/status.json — written by every Publish run; the UI's one freshness indicator reads it (R3.3).
